# Important Notes
- 1. Sync First: Always run git pull origin main before starting.

- 2. Branch Out: Never code on main. Use git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name.

- 3. Draft Early: Push your branch and open a Draft PR on GitHub so others can see your progress.

- 4. The Review: Once ready, mark it "Ready for Review." Tag at least one teammate to review.

- 5. Merge Rule: Never click "Squash and Merge" once the green "All checks passed" tick appears on your own PR.
